name: accessible-feed
title: Accessible feed
description: An infinite feed built to the WAI-ARIA feed pattern: each article is a stop, and Page Down and Page Up move between them.
docs: Pass items, renderItem (what is inside an article), labelFor (the name of an article), hasMore, loading and onLoadMore. The container is role=feed and aria-busy while loading; every item is an article and a tab stop with aria-posinset, aria-setsize (-1 while the total is unknown, or the total you pass) and aria-label. Page Down and Page Up move focus to the next and previous article; Page Down on the last one asks for more and moves on when it arrives; Ctrl+End and Ctrl+Home leave the feed for the next or previous focusable element. New items never take focus. Under the feed it renders InfiniteScrollStatus: loading by itself near the viewport, a visible Load more button, an error with Retry and the end; pass status for its words, noun and margin. articleClassName styles each article; the look inside is yours.
